entries.candidate: Data-center building at 800 Devon Ave, Elk Grove Village, Cook County IL (PINs 08343020340000/08343020350000; Class 6b applicant AMB Partners II Local L.P., a Prologis entity)
entries.reason: On 22 October 2026 the Cook County Board approved item 26-2576, a scrivener's-error correction (PIN number and title name) to its Class 6b incentive item 24-4682 for AMB Partners II Local L.P. at 800 Devon Avenue, whose proposed use is 'Industrial use - to create and build high-technology enterprises, commonly referred to as Data Centers or Data Farms' (Village of Elk Grove Village Resolution 21-23; local capture cook-county-legistar-matter-81383.json; the corrected text itself is in a Granicus attachment, which robots.txt disallows). The Assessor's permit feed (cook-permits-800-devon-block.json) shows the building already converted: 'INDUSTRIAL DATA CENTER BUILD OUT' (B24-0185, USD 70M, issued 25 July 2024), 'INDUSTRIAL DATA CENTER BUILD-OUT-PHASE 2' (B25-0518, USD 90M, 25 June 2025) and 'INDUSTRIAL DATA TENANT FIT-OUT' (B25-0387, USD 30M, 2 July 2025), all closed in the Assessor's workflow, and fence and gates (B26-0258, 7 April 2026). An announced status from the 22 October incentive record would understate a built facility, no dated in-window record observes completion or operation, and the operator is not identified.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated (within 85 days) Village, County or operator record of completion, occupancy or operation at 800 Devon Ave, naming the operator; locate with the Assessor centroid of PIN 08343020340000 (41.9937452, -87.9735336).

entries.candidate: Meta DeKalb Data Center (existing record imported:semiconductor-atlas:meta-dekalb-illinois): refresh to operational for the whole campus
entries.reason: Verifier (worker 1, iteration 39): the record covers a planned five-building campus of more than 2.3 million sq ft, of which two buildings were reported serving traffic in November 2023. The only in-window support for operational is a sentence in the City of DeKalb's 26 October 2026 tax-levy explanation (local dekalb-cc-agenda-10262026-2921.pdf) that Meta's EAV 'has largely stabilized as the facility has reached full build-out, occupancy, and assessment'. That does not establish that the whole recorded scope operates, so the refresh was narrowed to partially_operational on 26 October 2026 and operational is held.

entries.candidate: Proposed Microsoft data center, City of Kenosha, Kenosha County WI (about 242 acres north of State Highway 142 and east of County Highway MB; land bought by Microsoft in early 2025)
entries.reason: Not in the Atlas. The City of Kenosha's 'Data Center FAQs' page (Internet Archive copy of 28 August 2026; www.kenosha.org and the Kenosha County hosts answer automated clients with a Cloudflare challenge, so only archived copies were read) says 'Microsoft has proposed a data center on a 242-acre site in the City of Kenosha, north of Highway 142 and east of County Highway MB', that Microsoft bought the land in early 2025 and 'will need to complete a site plan process before building permits proceed', that 'The project remains in the early planning stages', and that Microsoft ended its NDA with the city on 22 June 2026. The page carries no publication or update date (it cites events up to 22 June 2026 and was first archived on 28 August 2026), the city's day-dated records found (land attachment and rezoning in November-December 2024, the joint announcement of 27 January 2025) are outside the window, no in-window Plan Commission or Council record was reachable (the archived current Plan Commission agenda is a 403), and Microsoft's Wisconsin local page (modified 20 October 2026) names only its Racine County campus. No parcel locator was obtained.
entries.reopen_condition: A day-dated in-window City of Kenosha, Kenosha County, State or Microsoft record that names the Kenosha data center (for example a site plan submission or approval, or a dated FAQ revision), plus an official parcel or address locator for the 242-acre site.
